title: When Does Context Routing Help? A Systematic Study of Multi-Modal Fusion in Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.25128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-modal time series forecasting methods integrate auxiliary context into temporal predictions through increasingly sophisticated fusion mechanisms. A growing body of work reports substantial gains, yet it is often unclear whether they reflect genuine use of the context or incidental architectural effects. We ask a narrower, checkable question: when can auxiliary context help a forecaster at all?   We identify two dataset-level conditions that must both hold: (1) the target is not dominated by a last-value shortcut (low autocorrelation rho_h), and (2) the context carries information about the target beyond history (non-zero conditional mutual information delta; when delta=0 no predictor can benefit---a distribution-free result). translated_title: 上下文路由何时有帮助？时间序列预测中多模态融合的系统研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25128v1 公告类型：新 摘要：多模态时间序列预测方法通过日益复杂的融合机制将辅助上下文整合到时间预测中。越来越多的研究报告了显著改进，但通常不清楚这些改进是否反映了上下文的真实使用，还是偶然的架构效应。我们提出了一个更狭窄、可检验的问题：辅助上下文何时能对预测器有所帮助？我们确定了两个必须同时成立的数据集级条件：（1）目标不受最后值捷径主导（低自相关ρ_h），（2）上下文携带关于目标的、超出历史的信息（非零条件互信息δ；当δ=0时，任何预测器都无法受益——这是一个无分布结果）。通过在MoME（一个14.3B参数的混合专家模型，6个数据集，10个随机种子）和四种在单骨干测试平台中实现的额外融合机制（5个数据集）上的受控实验，我们验证了这些条件。
tldr: 本文通过提出两个数据集级条件（低自相关和正条件互信息）来系统识别辅助上下文在多模态时间序列预测中何时真正有效，并通过大规模受控实验验证了这些条件。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically identifies when auxiliary context genuinely helps in multi-modal time series forecasting by proposing two dataset-level conditions (low autocorrelation and positive conditional mutual information), validated through large-scale controlled experiments.
